Plot flows of subjects between states over time

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/plotAlluvial.R, R/zzz-mae.R
plotAlluvial.Rd

plotAlluvial() draws the state of each subject at each time point as stacked strata and the subjects moving between states as flows.

Usage

plotAlluvial(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SummarizedExperiment'
plotAlluvial(
  x,
  state.col,
  time.col,
  group,
  min.flow = 1,
  missing = c("show", "drop"),
  ...
)

# S4 method for class 'MultiAssayExperiment'
plotAlluvial(x, ..., experiment = 1L)

Arguments

x

a SummarizedExperiment object.

...

additional arguments passed to ggalluvial::geom_flow.

state.col

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that contains the state of each sample, such as a community type or the dominant taxon.

time.col

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that contains the time points shared by the subjects: numeric, Date, POSIXct or, best, a factor of visits. Each distinct time is one axis.

group

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that identifies subjects.

min.flow

Integer scalar. Hides the paths through all time points followed by fewer subjects than this. (Default: 1)

missing

Character scalar. Draws time points without a sample or a state as a "missing" stratum ("show") or removes the subjects that have them ("drop"). (Default: "show")

experiment

Character scalar or integer scalar. For a MultiAssayExperiment, the experiment to plot; its samples get the colData of x. (Default: 1L)

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Requires the ggalluvial package. Subjects that follow the same states through all time points form one flow.

Examples

# Dominant genus at the first three samples of each subject
data("hitchip1006", package = "miaTime")
tse <- mia::addDominant(hitchip1006, name = "dominant", n = 4)
tse$visit <- ave(tse$time, tse$subject, FUN = rank)
tse <- tse[, tse$visit <= 3 &
    tse$subject %in% names(which(table(tse$subject) >= 2))]
tse$visit <- factor(tse$visit)
plotAlluvial(tse, state.col = "dominant", time.col = "visit",
    group = "subject")
